label: <DEL> step of long (L>=8) sequences starting with g (about to output g)
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (99.4% of mass), when the model is about to output the first original token. Strongly selective for that token being g (first_tok=g carries 89% of mass, lift 21x) and for long sequences: L=9 carries 78% of mass and L=8 22%. It is silent for L<=6, and L=7 has only 35 activations. Among L=9 sequences starting with g, 96% of delimiter steps fire; for L=8 the rate is lower. The strongest activations are L=9 g-initial sequences. The misses (about 12% of mass) are weak delimiter-step activations in L=9 sequences that start with other tokens (t, q, b, digits), plus a few tiny activations on the last original token (t=8). It does not fire during the copy phase or on earlier original-phase steps. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.88.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: g, t, q, b, 2, 3; least: f, 1, c, v) and the second original token (most: g, y, d, e, u, b; least: o, m, z, 1); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=9, t=8, L=9 & t=8.
